description: Changes a member's role within a Sentry team, ensuring the member is already part of the team and that any organization-level role restrictions are respected.

inputSchema.description: Parameters to switch a member's role within a Sentry team.

organization_id_or_slug.description: Identifier (ID or slug) for the Sentry organization.
organization_id_or_slug.title: Organization Id Or Slug

teamRole.description: Details for available team roles: `contributor` allows viewing/acting on events and most team project data; `admin` grants team administration privileges like managing projects and memberships.
teamRole.title: Team Role

team_id_or_slug.description: Identifier (ID or slug) for the Sentry team.
team_id_or_slug.title: Team Id Or Slug

inputSchema.title: SwitchTeamRoleForMemberRequest

name: switch_team_role_for_member

SwitchTeamRoleForMemberResponse.description: Response with the member's updated team information after a successful role change.

isActive.description: Indicates whether the member is currently active in the team.
isActive.title: Is Active

teamRole.description: The updated team role for the member. Returns `null` if the member's organization-level role (owner/manager/admin) overrides the team role, as they automatically receive minimum admin privileges on all teams.
teamRole.title: Team Role
